sources.name: agent-browser
sources.runtime: Rust page-automation CLI integrated into the YOLO-Web workspace as yolo-web; Bun coordinates higher-level workflows.
localPatches: Cargo workspace integration, yolo-web binary name, and shared workspace dependency versions
removed dashboard asset embedding and its UI dependency graph
sources.integration: Apache-2.0 Rust source is integrated at crates/agent-browser and builds as yolo-web, a specialized page automation executable. The top-level yolo orchestrator is a separate product target. Skill data live under packages/agent-browser-skills; dashboard and Node/pnpm launcher are excluded.
sources.removalPlan: Remove this source integration and lock entry if the browser agent is replaced.

sources.name: curl
sources.runtime: Native C application and libcurl; upstream build uses its supported CMake/Autotools workflows. Source files may carry additional SPDX licenses; preserve all SPDX notices and LICENSES entries.
sources.integration: Reference for curl CLI and libcurl behavior. Use the installed curl executable through Bun.spawn where an external transfer tool is needed; do not link this source snapshot into the Bun application.
sources.removalPlan: Remove the exported source directory and this lock entry if curl CLI/libcurl reference is no longer needed.

sources.name: wget2
sources.runtime: Native C application plus libwget; Wget2 CLI is GPL-3.0-or-later and libwget is LGPL-3.0-or-later. Upstream build uses native build tooling; no YOLO-Web binary link.
sources.integration: Reference for recursive transfer, mirror, and libwget APIs. Invoke a separately installed wget2 only through an explicit Bun.spawn integration; do not link or bundle this snapshot.
sources.removalPlan: Remove the exported source directory and this lock entry if no Wget2 CLI/libwget research remains.

sources.name: lightpanda-browser
sources.runtime: Native Zig browser implementation and upstream Zig build. AGPL-3.0-only source is retained for source-level study only; do not link, bundle, or redistribute a derived binary as part of YOLO-Web.
sources.integration: Compare CDP, DOM, JavaScript runtime, and headless browsing architecture at source level. No build integration, binary linking, or runtime dependency.
sources.removalPlan: Remove this reference snapshot and lock entry if source-level comparisons are no longer required.
